caption: The drawing features a rectangular frame outlined in black with sections of olive green, white, and red along the borders. Inside the frame, the background is primarily pink, bordered in red with decorative scalloped edges. In the center, there is a large black cross shape. On top of a rectangular pink area resembling a bed or platform, two human figures are positioned horizontally, with only their torsos, arms, and legs visible. The left figure, dressed in white and red, extends an arm toward the cross, while the right figure, wearing blue and white, is depicted upside down and extending a leg toward the cross. Below the right figure, there is a circular arrangement of yellow and green shapes. Near the bottom left, there is a small black object resembling crossed needles or pins. The overall color scheme consists of pink, red, white, olive green, black, blue, and yellow.
title: Plate 14: Main Altarpiece, Chimayo: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
